svg.text: The WiFiManager portal in a phone browser (illustration)
WiFiManager 2.0.17's original HTML, rendered at phone-screen width · the Wi-Fi names are only examples
tap your home Wi-Fi's name: the SSID box fills itself in
type its password (check Show Password to verify it)
tap Save; the ESP32 tries to connect
Fullstack IoT Developer curriculum · CC BY 4.0 · illustration, not a screenshot
